## READ-ONLY SYNC MONITOR
Inactive template with a closed code gate. It reads only the approved `fb_sync_state` columns. Shopify orders and sales events must have a successful checkpoint within two hours; the product catalog, customer/company directory, and Amazon order sources within eight hours; and GA4 traffic within 12 hours. No email, Sheet, Slack, Teams or other external output is connected.
